TOMISLAV MESARIĆ
Butcher | Meat Counter Assistant

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Butcher-trained meat counter professional with four years of customer service experience and practical experience in meat preparation, fresh sausage production, weighing and pricing customer orders, FIFO stock rotation, and daily cleaning routines. Experienced in preparing whole lambs and suckling pigs for events, weighing and pricing customer orders, and maintaining cold-room stock using FIFO. Basic HACCP knowledge.

KEY SKILLS
• Meat preparation and butchery
• Meat counter customer service
• Weighing and pricing orders; till operation
• Fresh sausage production and recipe development
• FIFO stock rotation and cold-room routines
• Basic HACCP knowledge
• Cleaning and maintaining slicers, mincers and meat-counter areas
• Hand pallet jack use
• English for customer service

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Butcher / Meat Counter Work | Mesnica Kod Ante | 2020–Present
• Prepare fresh sausages, producing approximately 40 kg per week during the busy season.
• Developed the shop’s lamb merguez recipe and adjusted the ćevapi mix to 70% beef and 30% lamb following customer feedback.
• Prepare whole lambs and suckling pigs for spit-roasting events, including ordering, butchering, seasoning and morning delivery.
• Completed orders for three weddings and approximately ten family parties annually from 2022 to 2025; the largest was four lambs and two pigs for a 180-guest wedding in Samobor in 2024.
• Ran a six-week dry-ageing trial on beef ribs at 21 and 28 days, recording temperature readings and weight loss.
• Rotate cold-room stock each morning, placing older stock at the front.

Meat Counter Service | Dolac Market Hall | Four years
• Serve customers at a meat stall; weigh and price orders and operate the till.
• Wrap customer meat orders in paper after weighing and pricing.
• Clean slicers and the mincer at the end of each day.
• Wrote a one-page closing and cleaning checklist for the slicer, mincer, counter and floor drain following a hygiene inspection remark in 2017.

EDUCATION & PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT
Butcher Training | Food Trades School | Completed 2015
Preparing for the Master Butcher Examination (majstorski ispit), Chamber of Trades | Planned spring 2027; not yet passed

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
HACCP: Basic knowledge
Equipment: Hand pallet jack experience; no forklift licence

I am applying for the Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant position at your Zagreb-Jarun store. I have completed butcher training and bring four years of meat-counter customer service experience, alongside practical butchery and meat preparation work.

In my work at Mesnica Kod Ante, I prepare fresh sausages—around 40 kg a week in the busy season—and prepare whole lambs and suckling pigs for events. My meat-counter experience includes weighing and pricing orders, operating the till, wrapping customer orders and keeping equipment and work areas clean. I have basic HACCP knowledge and take care with hygiene routines.

FreshCart’s emphasis on knowledgeable, friendly counter service and honest advice fits the kind of careful, customer-focused work I value. I would welcome the opportunity to bring my butchery training, practical experience and customer service skills to your team.

Kind regards,
Tomislav Mesarić

The tone fits FreshCart’s emphasis on knowledgeable service, hygiene, reliability, and product quality. A minor limitation is that it does not mention temperature-recording experience or make the connection to the job’s packaging and hygiene-check duties as explicitly as it could.

It correctly does not claim a forklift licence or supermarket self-service packing experience.
